# PREAMBLE

<br>

## Purpose of this session

<br>


During this training session, we will **integrate** a pair of samples into a single `SeuratObject` and into the same **multidimensional space**.

<br>

## The integration data set

We will still use data from the [Paiva et al.](https://www.cell.com/cell-reports/fulltext/S2211-1247(21)00281-3) publication.
    
While we focused on the **KO sample `TD3a`** until now, we will integrate it with its **wild-type** counterpart **`TDCT`**.

`TDCT` was processed in a very **similar manner** (QC, doublets, filtering, LogNormalization, HVGs and scaling) to what you performed for `TD3A`.
    
Both samples were **halved** for their number of cells, for practical reasons in the context of this training *(computation time)*
    
As the purpose is to **integrate** both samples into a single analytical entity, the objects we will use as input are `SeuratObjects` synced up to the data **scaling and regression** (thus, there are no *dimension reduction* data in these objects)

<br>
<br>

# Load input data

<br>

The data consists in a **pair of `SeuratObject`s** saved as RDS, one per sample.

<br>

## Fetch data

<br>

First, we **source** the fetching function script :

<br>

```{r}
#| label: source_fetch_funcs
#| filename: source_fetch_funcs
#| attr.output: '.details summary="Show output"'

## Name of the script to source
fetch_script <- "/shared/projects/2621_eb3in1_2026/atelier_scrnaseq/SOURCES/fetch_functions.R"

## Sourcing
source(file = fetch_script, echo = TRUE)
```

<br>

Now we can retrieve the input data :

<br>

```{r}
#| label: backup_integr
#| filename: backup_integr

## Copy the requested files from a local backup, return their user-based local paths

### The TD3A SeuratObject
TD3A_rds <- backup_get_data(
  backup_file = "/shared/projects/2621_eb3in1_2026/atelier_scrnaseq/DATA_BACKUP/INPUT/RDS/TD3A_Filtered_12508.2018.RDS",
  local_path = input_dir,
  force = TRUE)

### The TDCT SeuratObject
TDCT_rds <- backup_get_data(
  backup_file = "/shared/projects/2621_eb3in1_2026/atelier_scrnaseq/DATA_BACKUP/INPUT/RDS/TDCT_Filtered_12254.1868.RDS",
  local_path = input_dir,
  force = TRUE)
```

<br>

## Load into R

<br>

```{r}
#| label: rds_load
#| filename: rds_load

## Loading TD3A
TD3A_so <- readRDS(file = TD3A_rds)

## Loading TDCT
TDCT_so <- readRDS(file = TDCT_rds)
```

<br>

<br>

# Merge datasets

-   We simply merge the two objects into a single one :

```{r}
#| label: integr_merge
#| filename: integr_merge

TD3A_TDCT_merge <- base::merge(
  ## First object to merge
  x = TD3A_so, 
  ## Second object to merge
  y = TDCT_so, 
  ## Keep track of sample of origin for cells (optional)
  add.cell.ids = c("TD3A", "TDCT"), 
)
```

<br>

::: {.callout-note}
We used the `base::merge()` function, thus the one natively packaged with R, but one can see that we used a parameter specific to `SeuratObject` : `add.cell.ids`, which can sound counterintuitive.

This is because the **base::merge()** function, while being a generic one **can be modified** by additional packages, so that it adapts to **objects with new formats**.
:::

<br>

We can get a quick summary of the merged `SeuratObject` :

<br>

```{r}
#| label: merged_smry
#| filename: merged_smry

## A summary of the merged object
TD3A_TDCT_merge
```

<br>

::: {.callout-note icon="false" style="background: lightblue"}
## QUESTION 1A

What can you guess from the dimensions of `TD3A_TDCT_merge` on **the way it was merged** ?
:::

<br>

::: {.callout-note icon="false" collapse="true"}
## A HINT ?

To get to the answer, you'll have to **compare** its dimensions to those of the individual objects.
:::

<br>

::: {.callout-note icon="false" collapse="true" style="background: lightgreen"}
## ANSWER 1A

We check the dimensions of the three objects :

```{r}
#| label: dim_comp
#| filename: dim_comp

## TD3A
dim(TD3A_so)

## TDCT
dim(TDCT_so)

## Merged
dim(TD3A_TDCT_merge)
```

<br>

One can see that the **numbers of cells add up**, but **not those of features** !
:::

<br>
<br>

::: {.callout-note icon="false" style="background: lightblue"}
## QUESTION 1B

Thus, What can you actually guess **what happened for features** ?
:::

<br>

::: {.callout-note icon="false" collapse="true" style="background: lightgreen"}
## ANSWER 1B

We can compare the features in the individual and merged objects :

```{r}
#| label: featnames_comp
#| filename: featnames_comp

## Features of TD3A in TDCT
table(SeuratObject::Features(TD3A_so) %in% SeuratObject::Features(TDCT_so))

## Features of TDCT in TD3A
table(SeuratObject::Features(TDCT_so) %in% SeuratObject::Features(TD3A_so))

## Union of features
length(unique(c(SeuratObject::Features(TD3A_so), 
                SeuratObject::Features(TDCT_so))))

## Control

### Common features
feats_common <- intersect(SeuratObject::Features(TDCT_so), SeuratObject::Features(TD3A_so))
message("Common features : ", length(feats_common))

### TD3A only
TD3A_specific <- setdiff(SeuratObject::Features(TD3A_so), SeuratObject::Features(TDCT_so))
message("TD3A-specific : ", length(TD3A_specific))

### TDCT only
TDCT_specific <- setdiff(SeuratObject::Features(TDCT_so), SeuratObject::Features(TD3A_so))
message("TDCT-specific : ", length(TDCT_specific))

### TOTAL
sum(length(feats_common), 
    length(TD3A_specific), 
    length(TDCT_specific))
```

So, `Seurat` performed the **union** of the features from both individual objects
:::

<br>

::: {.callout-note}
This would remain true for **any number** of individual objects to merge !
:::

<br>

Now a bit of cleaning :

<br>

```{r}
#| label: merge_clean
#| filename: merge_clean

## Clean unneeded objects
rm(TD3A_so, TDCT_so, feats_common, TD3A_specific, TDCT_specific)
```

<br>

## Process the merged dataset

In order to visualize the data in a 2-D space, one needs to process it the way
one learnt :

```{r mproc}
#| label: merge_proc
#| filename: merge_proc

## All steps
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- Seurat::NormalizeData(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, verbose = FALSE)
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- Seurat::ScaleData(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, verbose = FALSE)
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- Seurat::RunPCA(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)
```


```{r elbow}
Seurat::ElbowPlot(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
```

```{r settingSampleCols, echo=FALSE}
sample_cols <- c("grey30", "indianred1")
```


```{r , message = FALSE}
Seurat::DimPlot(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, 
        reduction = "pca",
        group.by = "orig.ident", 
        cols = sample_cols)
```

```{r}
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- Seurat::RunUMAP(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, seed = my_seed, dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r}
Seurat::DimPlot(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge,
```

# Integration

## Seurat : [CCA](https://satijalab.org/seurat/reference/ccaintegration)

### CCA integration

```{r}
computing_time <- data.frame()
```


```{r cca integration, eval=TRUE}
start <- Sys.time()
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- IntegrateLayers(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, 
                                      orig.reduction = "pca",
                                      method = CCAIntegration, 
                                      new.reduction = "integrated.cca", 
                                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
end <- Sys.time()
computing_time["cca","comptime"] <- end-start
```

### Seurat : [RPCA](https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/integration_rpca)

```{r rPCA integration}
start <- Sys.time()
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- IntegrateLayers(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, 
                                      orig.reduction = "pca",
                                      method = RPCAIntegration, 
                                      new.reduction = "integrated.rpca", 
                                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
end <- Sys.time()
computing_time["rPCA","comptime"] <- end-start
```

### Seurat : [Harmony](https://satijalab.org/seurat/reference/harmonyintegration)

```{r harmony integration}
start <- Sys.time()
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- IntegrateLayers(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, 
                                      orig.reduction = "pca",
                                      method = HarmonyIntegration, 
                                      new.reduction = "harmony",
                                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
end <- Sys.time()
computing_time["Harmony","comptime"] <- end-start
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  computing_time
  )
```

Reductions(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge)

## Computing umap from "corrected" spaces

```{r cca umap, eval=TRUE}
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- RunUMAP(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, 
                           reduction = "integrated.cca", 
                           dims = 1:20, 
                           reduction.name = "umapcca")
```

```{r rpca umap, eval=TRUE}
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- RunUMAP(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, 
                           reduction = "integrated.rpca",
                           dims = 1:20, 
                           reduction.name = "umaprpca")
```

```{r harmony umap, eval=TRUE}
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- RunUMAP(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, 
                           reduction = "harmony", 
                           dims = 1:20, 
                           reduction.name = "umapharm")
```

```{r}
Reductions(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
no_corr <- DimPlot(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, group.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "umap", cols = sample_cols)+
  ggtitle("No Correction")+

cca_corr <- DimPlot(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, group.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "umapcca", cols = sample_cols)+
  ggtitle("CCA Integration")+
  theme_linedraw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5))

rpca_corr <- DimPlot(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, group.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "umaprpca", cols = sample_cols)+
  ggtitle("rPCA Integration")+
  theme_linedraw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5))

harm_corr <- DimPlot(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, group.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "umapharm", cols = sample_cols)+
  ggtitle("Harmony Integration")+

  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5))
```



### Clustering



##### Graph based on CCA Intgration

```{r, cca clustering, eval=TRUE}
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- FindNeighbors(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, 
                                 reduction = "integrated.cca", 
                                 dims = 1:20, 
                                 graph.name = "snn_cca")
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- FindClusters(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge,
                                graph.name = "snn_cca",
                                resolution = c(.5,.8,1), 
                                algorithm = 4)
```

##### Graph based on rPCA Intgration

```{r rpca clustering, eval=TRUE}
TD3A_TDCT_merge <- FindNeighbors(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge,

                                 dims = 1:20,

TD3A_TDCT_merge <- FindClusters(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge,
                                graph.name = "snn_rpca",
```

# Save the Seurat object

```{r saverds2, warning = FALSE, fold.output = FALSE, fold.plot = FALSE}
## A name for our Seurat object file (rich naming)
out_name <- paste0(
          output_dir, "/", paste(
            c("Twelve", Seurat::Project(TD3A_TDCT_merge), "S5", 
              "Integrated", paste(
                dim(TD3A_TDCT_merge), collapse = '.'
              )
            ), collapse = "_"),
            ".RDS")

## Check (I like this)
print(out_name)
```


```{r saverds2b, warning = FALSE, fold.output = FALSE, fold.plot = FALSE}
## Write on disk
saveRDS(object = TD3A_TDCT_merge, 
        file = out_name)
```
